en.t: The chanting voice was very low, only faintly audible,

units.source_text: 薰君听了又舍不得离开，说道：“实在隔得太严密了！

en.t: Lord Kaoru heard it and still could not bear to leave, saying, “They have shut me out far too strictly!
It is enough to suffocate me!”
He went on saying many more resentful things.
By this time the sky was gradually growing light,

units.source_text: 匂亲王从昨夜进去的门中走出来。

en.t: Prince Niou came out through the gate by which he had entered the night before.

units.source_text: 随着他的温和的动作发散出衣香。

en.t: With his gentle movements, the fragrance of his robes drifted out.

units.source_text: 他原是怀着窃玉偷香之心而仔细打扮的。

en.t: After all, he had dressed himself carefully with the intention of a secret tryst.

units.source_text: 弁君看见这个陌生的匂亲王走出来，甚是诧异，心中莫名其妙。

en.t: Ben no Kimi was very surprised to see this unfamiliar Prince Niou coming out, and could not make sense of it.

units.source_text: 但她相信薰君决不会在两女公子面上做坏事，也就放心了。

en.t: But she believed that Lord Kaoru would never do anything improper with regard to the two young ladies, and so she felt relieved.
